title: Lebanon Update — May 10, 2026
summary: Israeli operations across Lebanon killed at least 2,750 people since March 2 resumption of hostilities, with 24+ killed on May 9 alone including seven in al-Saksakieh. Hezbollah SG Qassem declared 'there is no ceasefire,' citing 10,000+ violations since April 16. PM Salam visited Damascus, reporting 'significant progress' with Syrian President al-Sharaa on security and economic cooperation. President Aoun rejected a US push for a meeting with Netanyahu, insisting attacks must stop first. Washington DC negotiations between Israel and Lebanon were set for May 14-15. Parliamentary elections scheduled for May 10 were postponed due to ongoing conflict.
